description: Formal complaint, claim, request and suggestion cases, one row per case. Typed, normalized and checked from workspace.bronze.complaints. Use for demand sizing and the case-timing baseline only: product links, claimed amounts and outcome fields are random or stale (issues 1-5) and are flagged, nulled or re-derived here. Nothing in this table is a valid label or grounding source for a dispute.

load.notes: Daily files partitioned by process_date. Reads workspace.bronze.products (ownership) and workspace.bronze.transactions (claim traceability) on every run; ageing uses the fixed as-of date 2026-06-18 (dataset end). Incremental runs do not re-evaluate older cases when products or transactions change: run mode=full for that.

complaint_id.description: Case identifier (CMP- + 20 alphanumerics), trimmed and upper-cased. Primary key.

event_ts.description: Case creation time (from creation_date). The event time for trends, ageing and SLA.

event_date.description: Calendar date of event_ts. Use this, not process_date, for daily aggregates and temporal splits.

process_date.description: Business-day cut-off of the source system (previous day for 33.7% of cases). Partition/pruning key only.

customer_id.description: Complainant (CLI- + 12 alphanumerics); found in customers for 67,095 / 67,095 cases.

category.description: Case category (English, 19.7-20.2% each). Transactions and Fees form the dispute slice (see dispute_type).

subcategory.description: FIX: subcategory (Spanish), imputed from category when missing; it is a 1:1 function of category, so it adds no information and leaks the category.

subcategory_imputed.description: FLAG: true when the delivered subcategory was NULL and was imputed from category (6,698 cases, 9.98%).

dispute_type.description: Dispute slice used for sizing: 'unrecognized_charge' for Transactions (Cargo no reconocido), 'incorrect_charge_or_fee' for Fees (Cobro indebido), NULL for other categories. Matches the intent-classifier class names.

reception_channel.description: Channel the case was received through (Regulator = 1.07%).

affected_product_id.description: QUARANTINE: product the case refers to, kept only when the complainant owns it; NULL otherwise. NULL in every delivered row (0 of 44,570 links are owned by the complainant). Never ground a dispute on it.

affected_product_id_raw.description: Product id as delivered (trimmed, upper-cased); present in 44,570 cases, all found in products, none owned by the complainant.

product_not_owned.description: FLAG: a product id was delivered but it is missing from products or belongs to another customer (44,570 cases).

related_branch_id.description: Branch the case refers to (SUC- + 8 alphanumerics); present in 28.6% of cases, 0 orphans.

origin_interaction_id.description: Contact that originated the case. NULL in 67,095 / 67,095 rows: calls cannot be linked to cases.

link_status.description: FLAG: 'unlinked' when origin_interaction_id is NULL (every delivered case), else 'linked'. No fuzzy re-linking: same-day contacts match at chance level.

description.description: Case description. Five fixed strings, one per category ('Queja relacionada con <category>'): kept for display, label-leaking, never a feature.

claimed_amount.description: Amount claimed by the customer as delivered, in currency. Random: Uniform(50-5,000) in every currency and 0 of 21,751 match a transaction of the customer. Never FX-convert or sum it.

currency.description: Currency of claimed_amount (ISO 4217, upper-cased). The customer's home currency in only 24.9% of cases.

claim_untraceable.description: FLAG: the case carries a claimed amount or currency, but no transaction of the complainant has that amount to the cent (in its own currency, or amount_usd for USD). False when there is no claim or it traces to a transaction.

status.description: Case status as delivered. Open, In Process and Escalated are open states. It does not age (see stale_status): never answer a customer from it.

assigned_agent_id.description: Agent assigned to the case (AGT- + 10 alphanumerics); NULL when unassigned.

assignment_date.description: Assignment time; NULL for Open and Rejected cases and for about 5% of the others.

first_response_date.description: First response time; only for In Process, Resolved and Closed cases (about 5% missing).

first_response_hours.description: Hours from creation to first response (observed 3-72 h; p50 37 h for disputes, 26.2% above 48 h). Baseline for the intake's immediate case number.

resolution_date.description: Resolution time; only for Resolved and Closed cases.

closing_date.description: Closing time; only for Closed cases (1-7 days after resolution).

resolution_days.description: Days from creation to resolution as delivered (1-30). Equals datediff(resolution_date, creation) wherever both exist; each is missing alone in about 700 rows.

resolution.description: Resolution text: five fixed Spanish templates, unrelated to compensation. Post-intake: never a feature.

sla_breached.description: SLA flag as delivered. Random (20.1%, flat across priority, resolution and response times): never a label or KPI; use sla_derived.

sla_derived.description: FIX: SLA breach derived from the dates, with documented targets of first response within 48 h and resolution within 30 days. The response is the first of first_response_date, resolution_date and closing_date; open cases are aged at the end of the as-of date 2026-06-18. True = a target was missed; false = every evaluable target was met; NULL = a closed or rejected case without any response date.

stale_status.description: FLAG: the case is still Open, In Process or Escalated more than 30 days after creation at the as-of date 2026-06-18 (dataset end). The delivered status never ages, so these statuses are not current.

compensation_amount.description: FIX: amount granted, typed from compensation_granted (which holds amounts, not a boolean): 4,641 cases, 10.15-499.98, only on Resolved or Closed cases. Currency is not delivered.

compensation_flag.description: FIX: true when a compensation amount above 0 was granted (28.8% of the 16,121 resolved or closed cases); false otherwise, including open cases. Independent of the resolution text: never a label.

resolution_satisfaction.description: Satisfaction with the resolution on 1-5; only for Closed cases. Flat across cases: never a label.

is_repeat_complainer.description: Repeat-complainer flag as delivered (15.0%). Random: 15.1% of customers with a single case carry it, the same rate as repeat cases. Never a feature.

checks.name: complaint_id_format
checks.description: Identifier follows the CMP- + 20 alphanumerics pattern.

checks.name: customer_id_format
checks.description: Customer identifier follows the CLI- + 12 alphanumerics pattern.

checks.name: process_date_is_cutoff
checks.expr: process_date IS NULL OR event_date IS NULL OR process_date BETWEEN date_sub(event_date, 1) AND event_date
checks.description: process_date is the creation date or the previous business day, never later.

checks.name: subcategory_matches_category
checks.expr: subcategory = CASE category WHEN 'Transactions' THEN 'Cargo no reconocido' WHEN 'Fees' THEN 'Cobro indebido' WHEN 'Technical' THEN 'Problema con app' WHEN 'Branch' THEN 'Atención en sucursal' WHEN 'Service' THEN 'Calidad de servicio' END
checks.description: Subcategory is the one its category implies (1:1), which is what makes the imputation valid.

checks.name: dates_after_creation
checks.expr: coalesce(assignment_date >= event_ts, true) AND coalesce(first_response_date >= event_ts, true) AND coalesce(resolution_date >= event_ts, true) AND coalesce(closing_date >= event_ts, true)
checks.description: No lifecycle date precedes the case creation.

checks.name: closing_after_resolution
checks.expr: closing_date IS NULL OR resolution_date IS NULL OR closing_date >= resolution_date
checks.description: A case closes on or after its resolution.

checks.name: resolution_after_first_response
checks.expr: resolution_date IS NULL OR first_response_date IS NULL OR resolution_date >= first_response_date
checks.description: A case is resolved on or after its first response (the generator breaks this in a few hundred cases).

checks.name: status_dates_consistent
checks.expr: (resolution_date IS NULL OR status IN ('Resolved', 'Closed')) AND (closing_date IS NULL OR status = 'Closed') AND (first_response_date IS NULL OR status IN ('In Process', 'Resolved', 'Closed')) AND (assignment_date IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('Open', 'Rejected'))
checks.description: Lifecycle dates only exist for the statuses that reach them.

checks.name: resolution_days_consistent
checks.expr: resolution_days IS NULL OR resolution_date IS NULL OR resolution_days = datediff(to_date(resolution_date), event_date)
checks.description: resolution_days equals the calendar days between creation and resolution.

checks.name: compensation_only_when_resolved
checks.expr: compensation_amount IS NULL OR status IN ('Resolved', 'Closed')
checks.description: Compensation is only granted on resolved or closed cases.

checks.name: claim_amount_and_currency_paired
checks.description: A claimed amount comes with its currency and vice versa (random missingness breaks this).

checks.name: origin_interaction_linked
checks.description: The case is linked to its originating contact (fails for every delivered case).

checks.name: product_owned_by_complainant
checks.description: The delivered product belongs to the complainant; failures are nulled in affected_product_id.

checks.name: claim_traceable
checks.description: The claimed amount matches a transaction of the complainant, or no claim was made.

checks.name: status_not_stale
checks.description: Open cases are at most 30 days old at the as-of date.

checks.name: sla_flag_matches_dates
checks.expr: sla_breached IS NULL OR sla_derived IS NULL OR sla_breached = sla_derived
checks.description: The delivered SLA flag agrees with the date-derived breach (it is random, so it mostly does not).
